title: Over the Earth
caption: The whole 310 m ship from the starboard bow: the science section and cold radiators in front, the 120 m habitat ring amidships and the drive at the far end.

title: Habitat ring
caption: The 0.6 g crew ring with its four elevator spokes and stay rods, turning round the still hub that holds the zero-g labs and the cupola.

title: Science section
caption: The bow from the port side: the survey telescope in front of its foil sunshade, the scan platform, the nine probes on their racks and the sample lab above the spine.

title: Under thrust
caption: The drive at full power from the stern quarter: fusion exhaust leaving the magnetic nozzle, and the four radiator wings glowing in the shadow of the shield.
